title: Payment API database connection pool exhaustion
resolution: Increased pool capacity after confirming database headroom and fixed a connection leak in the payment worker.

title: Checkout API DNS failure for inventory dependency
resolution: Restored DNS resolver availability and verified the inventory endpoint resolution.

title: Orders API error spike after deployment
resolution: Rolled back the release after identifying an incompatible request-schema change.

title: Database connectivity investigation
steps: Check database availability, latency, and active connection count.
Compare pool utilization and configuration before and after the incident.
Inspect application logs for unreleased or long-running connections.

title: DNS and downstream dependency investigation
steps: Check DNS resolver health and recent resolver configuration changes.
Verify that the downstream endpoint resolves from the affected service network.
Compare downstream latency and error metrics with the incident start time.

title: Post-deployment regression investigation
steps: Compare error rate and latency before and after the latest deployment.
Review changed configuration and API-contract changes in the release.
Prepare a rollback decision for engineer approval if the regression is confirmed.
